-- Normalize customer addresses before geocoding
CREATE TEMP TABLE cleaned_address_staging AS
SELECT
    raw_table.customer_ref_id,
    CASE
        WHEN raw_table.address_1 IS NULL OR TRIM(raw_table.address_1) = '' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN raw_table.address_2 IS NOT NULL THEN raw_table.address_2
                ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
            END
        ELSE TRIM(raw_table.address_1)
    END AS address_line_primary,
    CASE
        WHEN raw_table.address_2 = raw_table.address_1 THEN NULL
        ELSE raw_table.address_2
    END AS address_line_secondary,
    UPPER(raw_table.postal_code_raw) AS postal_code_clean
FROM legacy_import.raw_table AS raw_table
WHERE raw_table.customer_ref_id IS NOT NULL;

-- Flag rows where the primary line still looks like a PO box
UPDATE cleaned_address_staging
SET address_line_secondary = address_line_primary
WHERE address_line_primary LIKE 'PO BOX%'
  AND address_line_secondary IS NULL;

-- Report how many customer_ref_id values lost their address_1 entirely
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT raw_table.customer_ref_id) AS missing_primary_count
FROM legacy_import.raw_table AS raw_table
LEFT JOIN cleaned_address_staging
    ON cleaned_address_staging.customer_ref_id = raw_table.customer_ref_id
WHERE cleaned_address_staging.address_line_primary = 'UNKNOWN'
  AND raw_table.postal_code_raw IS NOT NULL;

Farmers in Enugu State say a small processing collective has changed the economics of cassava in their district. The Okwuosa-Ndubuisi Cassava Growers' Cooperative, founded in 2019 by eleven households, now buys roots from more than four hundred smallholders and dries them into flour at a solar-powered mill outside Nsukka. Members say the arrangement lets them avoid middlemen who once paid a fraction of the market price at harvest time.

The chairwoman, Chiamaka Okwuosa-Ndubuisi, said the group had grown faster than anyone expected. 'We started with one grinder and a borrowed truck,' she told reporters on Tuesday. Her late father-in-law had organized the first meetings, and the cooperative still carries the family name.

State officials have begun citing the Okwuosa-Ndubuisi model in budget hearings, arguing that similar mills could be funded in three neighboring local government areas. Critics warn that the cooperative's success depends heavily on a single buyer, a biscuit manufacturer in Onitsha, and could falter if that contract lapses next spring.

For now, demand appears steady. Last month the Okwuosa-Ndubuisi mill processed roughly ninety tonnes of fresh roots, its highest total yet, and the growers voted to add a second drying shed before the rainy season. Chiamaka Okwuosa-Ndubuisi said applications to join had tripled since January.

Vorimexatrolide is an investigational oral inhibitor of the cardiac late sodium current that is being studied for recurrent atrial fibrillation. In early-phase trials, vorimexatrolide shortened the duration of arrhythmic episodes without measurably prolonging the QT interval, a property that distinguishes it from older class III agents.

Absorption is rapid, with peak plasma concentrations reached about ninety minutes after a dose. The compound is extensively metabolized by CYP3A4 to an active desmethyl derivative, so strong inhibitors of that enzyme, such as clarithromycin or ketoconazole, can roughly double exposure to vorimexatrolide and its metabolite. Investigators therefore excluded patients taking those drugs from the second-phase study.

The most frequently reported adverse effects were dizziness, mild nausea and transient elevations in hepatic transaminases. Two participants discontinued vorimexatrolide because of persistent headache; no cases of torsades de pointes were observed during twelve weeks of monitoring.

Dosing recommendations remain provisional. Current protocols begin at 50 mg twice daily and allow titration to 100 mg in patients with normal renal function. Because the desmethyl metabolite is cleared by the kidneys, researchers plan a dedicated pharmacokinetic study of vorimexatrolide in people with moderate to severe renal impairment before any larger efficacy trial begins.

In the spring of 1887 the engineer Bartholomew Szczepankiewicz arrived in Baltimore with a set of drawings that would occupy him for the rest of his life. Born in Krakow and trained in Vienna, Szczepankiewicz had spent a decade designing sewer outfalls along the Danube before an American contractor persuaded him to cross the Atlantic.

His first employer was the newly chartered Eastern Seaboard Drainage Office, known in municipal correspondence simply as the ESDO. The agency had been created to coordinate stormwater projects among a dozen quarreling port towns, but it possessed little money and less authority. Within two years Szczepankiewicz had become its chief surveyor, and the ESDO began to issue binding specifications for culvert gradients and brick thickness.

Local aldermen resented the arrangement. Several newspapers accused the ESDO of favoring foreign methods over American experience, and one cartoon depicted Szczepankiewicz as a mole tunneling beneath City Hall. The criticism faded after the flood of 1889, when districts built to his standards drained within hours while older neighborhoods stood under water for days.

Historians now credit the partnership with shaping coastal infrastructure well into the twentieth century. The ESDO archives, rediscovered in a Philadelphia warehouse in 1974, contain more than three thousand sheets signed by Szczepankiewicz, many annotated in Polish.

Die Beiträge für die Kraftfahrzeughaftpflichtversicherung steigen im kommenden Jahr erneut deutlich. Nach Angaben des Branchenverbands müssen Autofahrer im Durchschnitt mit einem Aufschlag von rund acht Prozent rechnen. Als Gründe nennen die Versicherer vor allem höhere Werkstattkosten und teurere Ersatzteile.

Besonders betroffen sind junge Fahrer, die ohnehin schon hohe Prämien zahlen. Wer seine Kraftfahrzeughaftpflichtversicherung wechseln möchte, sollte die Kündigungsfrist beachten: In den meisten Verträgen endet sie am 30. November. Verbraucherschützer raten dazu, mehrere Angebote zu vergleichen und dabei nicht nur auf den Preis zu achten.

Auch der Bund der Versicherten hat sich zu Wort gemeldet. Der Verein kritisiert, dass viele Kunden die Bedingungen ihrer Kraftfahrzeughaftpflichtversicherung kaum kennen. So seien etwa Schäden durch Mietwagen im Ausland nicht immer abgedeckt, obwohl viele Reisende davon ausgingen.

Die Landesregierung in Hannover prüft unterdessen, ob die Aufsichtsbehörde strenger kontrollieren soll, wie die Unternehmen ihre Tarife berechnen. Ein entsprechender Bericht der Verbraucherzentrale Niedersachsen soll im Frühjahr vorgelegt werden. Darin geht es auch um die Frage, ob Rabatte für Telematiktarife bei der Kraftfahrzeughaftpflichtversicherung fair verteilt werden. Erste Ergebnisse deuten darauf hin, dass vor allem ältere Fahrer von solchen Modellen profitieren, während die Verbraucherzentrale Niedersachsen für Berufspendler kaum Vorteile erkennt.

La Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir ha anunciado nuevas restricciones de riego para los agricultores de la campiña sevillana. Según el organismo, los embalses de la cuenca se encuentran al veintidós por ciento de su capacidad, una de las cifras más bajas de la última década.

Los regantes de Écija y Carmona recibieron la noticia con preocupación. Muchos de ellos dependen de los cultivos de algodón y olivar, que necesitan agua durante los meses de verano. Un portavoz de la asociación local aseguró que la Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir no había consultado a los productores antes de tomar la decisión.

El presidente del organismo defendió la medida en una rueda de prensa celebrada el lunes. Explicó que la prioridad es garantizar el abastecimiento de las ciudades y que la Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir revisará las dotaciones cada mes si llegan las lluvias de otoño.

Mientras tanto, la Junta de Andalucía estudia ayudas directas para compensar las pérdidas. Fuentes del gobierno autonómico indicaron que el paquete podría superar los cuarenta millones de euros y que se coordinaría con la Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir para identificar las explotaciones más afectadas. Las organizaciones agrarias, por su parte, han convocado una concentración frente a la sede de la Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir en la plaza de España para el próximo jueves.

Around the region this week: In Tulsa, bakery owner Renata Vasquez opened a second shop near the river. A ferry linking Bar Harbor to Winter Harbor resumed service after repairs costing 2.1 million dollars. Councilman Dewey Hartono of Fresno proposed limits on gas-powered leaf blowers. Firefighters in Boise rescued a golden retriever from a drainage culvert on Monday. The Gilcrest Public Library received a donation of 600 rare atlases from collector Imogen Paltrow. A startup called Brightvane unveiled a folding electric scooter at a trade fair in Austin. Students at Marlow Academy in Duluth won a state robotics title with a machine named Pickle. Officials in Savannah closed two beaches after high bacteria readings. Retired pilot Hugo Lindqvist, 91, flew a restored biplane over Lake Placid. A Kentucky distillery, Copper Hollow, recalled 4,000 bottles because of faulty seals. In Reno, a casino worker named Tasha Greer found a lost diamond ring valued at about eighteen thousand. The mayor of Burlington, Felix Amadi, signed an order expanding bike lanes. Grocery chain Hartfield Market said it will stop selling plastic bags by June. A Tucson dentist, Omar Szabo, ran his 100th marathon in Phoenix. Finally, a pumpkin grown by Lorna Sweeney of Half Moon Bay weighed a record 2,560 pounds.

Many common medications act through very different mechanisms. Metformin lowers hepatic glucose output and is usually the first choice for type 2 diabetes. Lisinopril blocks angiotensin-converting enzyme, reducing blood pressure. Atorvastatin inhibits HMG-CoA reductase in the liver. Omeprazole suppresses gastric acid by binding the proton pump. Sertraline selectively prevents serotonin reuptake at the synapse. Warfarin interferes with vitamin K recycling and requires regular INR checks. Levothyroxine replaces missing thyroid hormone in hypothyroid patients. Amoxicillin, a beta-lactam antibiotic, disrupts bacterial cell wall synthesis. Albuterol relaxes airway smooth muscle through beta-2 receptor stimulation. Gabapentin binds calcium channel subunits and is used for nerve pain. Furosemide acts on the loop of Henle to promote diuresis. Prednisone, a corticosteroid, dampens broad inflammatory signaling. Ondansetron antagonizes 5-HT3 receptors to relieve nausea after chemotherapy. Allopurinol targets xanthine oxidase and helps prevent gout flares. Clopidogrel stops platelets from aggregating via P2Y12. Montelukast occupies leukotriene receptors in asthma. Tamsulosin eases urinary flow via alpha-1A blockade. Digoxin slows ventricular rate in atrial flutter. Methotrexate limits folate metabolism in rheumatoid arthritis. Finally, donepezil raises acetylcholine levels in mild Alzheimer disease.

The year 1848 brought upheaval across Europe. In Paris, Alphonse de Lamartine helped proclaim the Second Republic in February. Klemens von Metternich fled Vienna for England in March. Lajos Kossuth rallied Magyar deputies in Pressburg for constitutional reform. Giuseppe Mazzini returned from exile to support uprisings in Milan. In Berlin, King Frederick William IV briefly bowed to crowds after street fighting. Frantisek Palacky convened a Slavic congress in Prague that June. The Frankfurt Parliament met in St. Paul's Church under Heinrich von Gagern. Danish forces clashed with Schleswig rebels near Bov. In Sicily, revolt in Palermo had erupted as early as January. Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels published a short manifesto from a small print shop in Soho. Pope Pius IX fled Rome for Gaeta in November. Alfred Windischgraetz crushed resistance in Bohemia. Wallachian liberals led by Nicolae Balcescu issued the Islaz Proclamation. Polish volunteers fought in Poznan under Ludwik Mieroslawski. Across the Atlantic, the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo ended a separate war. Louis Napoleon Bonaparte won the French presidential vote in December. By the following summer, Russian troops under Ivan Paskevich had forced Arthur Gorgei to surrender at Vilagos.

Kurz notiert aus den Regionen: In Freiburg eröffnete die Bäckerin Hanna Wiegand ein Café am Münsterplatz. Der Stadtrat von Lübeck beschloss neue Parkgebühren für die Altstadt. In Dresden stellte das Start-up Lumora eine faltbare Solarlampe vor. Die Feuerwehr Görlitz befreite eine Katze aus einem Lüftungsschacht. Bürgermeister Tobias Ernst aus Ulm kündigte einen Radweg entlang der Donau an. Im Allgäu fand ein Wanderer namens Jens Kohlhaas einen römischen Ring. Die Brauerei Steinquell aus Bamberg brachte ein alkoholfreies Rauchbier auf den Markt. Schüler aus Kiel gewannen einen Robotikwettbewerb mit einem Gerät namens Krümel. In Erfurt schloss das Kaufhaus Brenner nach 74 Jahren. Die Schauspielerin Mila Ostrowski erhielt in Potsdam einen Nachwuchspreis. Ein Sturm entwurzelte in Rostock mehrere Linden. Der Zoo Leipzig meldete die Geburt eines Okapis. In Trier wurde ein Mosaik aus dem dritten Jahrhundert freigelegt. Landwirt Peter Haas aus Cloppenburg erntete einen Kürbis von 612 Kilogramm. Die Pianistin Yuki Brandt spielte in Bonn vor ausverkauftem Saal. In Kassel testet die Firma Velotek autonome Lastenräder. Schließlich verlängerte der Fährbetrieb auf Sylt seinen Winterfahrplan bis März.

Breves de la semana: En Valladolid, la panadera Lucía Herrero abrió un segundo local junto a la catedral. El ayuntamiento de Cádiz aprobó una nueva tasa turística. Un ciclista llamado Andrés Quiroga ganó la clásica de Ourense. En Zaragoza, la empresa Novalto presentó un patinete plegable. Los bomberos de Logroño rescataron a un perro atrapado en una alcantarilla. La biblioteca de Cáceres recibió trescientos mapas antiguos donados por la coleccionista Inés Barral. En Murcia, una tormenta de granizo dañó cultivos de lechuga. El alcalde de Gijón, Ramón Varela, inauguró un carril bici frente al mar. Alumnos de un instituto de Huesca vencieron en un concurso de robótica con una máquina llamada Pimiento. La bodega Sierra Alta retiró cuatro mil botellas por un defecto en los corchos. En Palma, la pintora Marta Font expuso cuarenta acuarelas. Un granjero de Lugo cosechó una calabaza de quinientos kilos. El museo de Mérida restauró un mosaico romano del siglo segundo. La cantante Rocío Vidal llenó el auditorio de Pamplona. En Burgos, la startup Quesería Nube lanzó un queso de oveja ahumado. Por último, el puerto de Almería registró un récord de cruceros en octubre.
